title: Savory Hwajeon Pancakes with Flax and Umami
description: A fusion Korean-inspired hwajeon pancake with a nutty flax topping and umami-rich sesame oil.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together hwajeon flour and water until smooth.
2. Add sesame oil, salt, and 1/4 cup scallions; stir until combined.
3. Using a non-stick skillet over medium heat, pour batter and spread evenly.
4. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until bubbles appear on surface and edges start to curl.
5. Flip pancakes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, mix flaxseed meal, remaining scallions, and crumbled tofu in a bowl.
7. Once pancakes are cooked, top with flaxseed mixture and serve immediately.
8. Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
9. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
